verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no downloadable machine-readable API spec for mise, whether OpenAPI or an equivalent such as a machine-readable CLI spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI path returning 404. The llms.txt file, the CLI docs and the MCP server are related AI-facing features, not a downloadable API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
